findings: [subtitle] The file subtitle misprints «издеателем» for «издателем» (izdatelem, 'by the publisher'); the heading in [1] has the correct «ИЗДАТЕЛЕМ». Translated as 'by the Publisher'.
[78] «людей, желающих преобразования его» (its transformation): singular «его» though the antecedent «правительства» (governments) is plural; translated as printed ('to transform it').

[85] «ЗАКЛЮЧЕНИЕ» ('Conclusion') stands between the two opening thoughts of 25 March and its numbered thoughts, followed by two page markers (p. 429 with no text); possibly misplaced or a remnant of the source layout. Translated as printed.

[97]-[100] Signed «Чаннинг» (Channing), but [97] (from 'For a person's happiness') and [98] are from Thomas Paine, The Age of Reason, Part I ('Infidelity does not consist in believing, or in disbelieving...'); [99] also echoes Paine. Attribution kept as printed.

[131] «под видом либерализма науки, философии, религии»: possibly a dropped comma after «либерализма» (liberalizma, 'liberalism'); translated as printed ('the liberalism of science, philosophy, religion').

[136] «Томас Бейн» (Tomas Beyn) is a slip for «Пейн» (Peyn, Paine): the quotation is the opening of Paine's Common Sense ('Society is produced by our wants, and government by our wickedness'). Rendered 'Thomas Paine.'
[137] «не участие» printed as two words (cf. «неучастием», neuchastiem, in [133]); translated 'nonparticipation'.
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. The English follows the printed reading (or its evident sense where marked) and the unit stays reviewed; Confirm against the printed volume 42 at the next print-witness pass.
